title: About Us
content: Green World Health Solutions offers quality health and wellness products to customers across Kenya. We make it easy to shop online, register as a customer or distributor, and get friendly guidance when you need it. Contact us at info@greenworldhealth.co.ke.

title: Shipping & Delivery
content: We offer reliable delivery across Kenya. Nairobi orders are typically delivered same or next business day; countrywide delivery takes 1-4 business days. Pay by M-Pesa, card or on delivery.
